proposed_widenings.name: upgrade_prior_feature_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: This level-14 feature does not grant a fixed standalone payload. It upgrades whichever Blessed Strikes option the cleric chose earlier, so the surface needs an honest way to target and refine a prior feature choice instead of pretending both branches apply or splitting one SRD unit into two fake units.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The option you chose for Blessed Strikes grows more powerful.

proposed_widenings.name: non_spell_triggered_passive_operation
proposed_widenings.justification: The Potent Spellcasting branch is a passive triggered rider, not an activation and not an elapsed-time passive operation. The current class-feature surface has passive grants and elapsed-time passive operations only, so it cannot model a trigger like dealing damage with a cleric cantrip.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you cast a Cleric cantrip and deal damage to a creature with it, you can give vitality to yourself or another creature within 60 feet of yourself

proposed_widenings.name: dice_amount_ability_modifier_multiplier
proposed_widenings.justification: Temporary Hit Points equal to twice Wisdom modifier cannot be expressed by the current DiceExpr shape, which allows one ability modifier but no multiplier.
proposed_widenings.evidence: granting a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wisdom modifier

notes: No honest content record was authored. Divine Strike is an upgrade to an existing prior-choice rider, and Potent Spellcasting also needs a non-spell triggered passive operation plus a 2x ability-mod amount expression.
